name: Red & Yellow Box Dual-Object Procedure
description: Astronaut opens container, extracts red box first, extracts yellow box, returns both yellow and red boxes into container, and closes the box.

0.name: IDLE
0.instruction: System initialized. Please open the primary container box.

1.name: CONTAINER_OPEN
1.instruction: Container open. Next step: Please extract the red box.

2.name: RED_EXTRACTED
2.instruction: Red box extracted. Next step: Please extract the yellow box.

3.name: YELLOW_EXTRACTED
3.instruction: Yellow box extracted. Next step: Please return both yellow and red boxes into the container.

4.name: OBJECTS_RETURNED
4.instruction: Yellow and red boxes returned. Next step: Please close the container box.

5.name: COMPLETE
5.instruction: Container box closed. Dual-object procedure successfully completed.

ERROR_SEQ.alert_tts: Warning: Wrong move! Red box must be extracted before yellow box. Please return the yellow box.
ERROR_SEQ.recovery_prompt: Please return the yellow box into the container and extract the red box first.

ERROR_SKIP.alert_tts: Warning: Wrong move! Step skipped. Please complete the extraction sequence before closing.
ERROR_SKIP.recovery_prompt: Please reopen the container and complete the required steps.

ERROR_UNRETURNED_CLOSE.alert_tts: Warning: Wrong move! Yellow and red boxes must be returned into the container before closing.
ERROR_UNRETURNED_CLOSE.recovery_prompt: Reopen container and return both boxes inside before closing.

STALL_TIMEOUT.alert_tts: Notice: Inactivity detected. Please proceed with the current step.

ERROR_REGRESSION.alert_tts: Warning: Wrong move! A completed step has been undone. Please redo the step.
ERROR_REGRESSION.recovery_prompt: Please redo the reverted step to continue the procedure.

ERROR_TECHNIQUE.alert_tts: Warning: Unsafe technique detected. Please adjust your posture.
ERROR_TECHNIQUE.recovery_prompt: Adjust your arm angles and posture before continuing.
